chapters.name: Units, Dimensions and Errors
chapters.notes: Both syllabi include dimensional analysis, least count, significant figures and errors.

chapters.name: Experimental Physics
chapters.notes: Main Unit 20 lists 18 experiments; Advanced lists a shorter set under General Physics (adds post office box). Experiments span Class 11 and 12; NCERT lab manual, not a textbook chapter.

chapters.name: Motion in a Plane
chapters.notes: Projectile motion, relative velocity and uniform circular motion. Advanced restricts kinematics to Cartesian coordinates.

chapters.name: Laws of Motion and Friction
chapters.notes: Advanced names uniformly accelerated (non-inertial) frames; Main names banked roads and circular-motion dynamics.

chapters.name: Centre of Mass, Momentum and Collisions
chapters.notes: Coaching usually teaches this separately from rotation, though NCERT combines them in Ch 6.

chapters.name: Rotational Motion
chapters.notes: Advanced adds rolling without slipping and collisions of point masses with rigid bodies explicitly.

chapters.name: Gravitation
chapters.notes: Geostationary orbits are named in Advanced but not in Main 2026 (reported removed from Main in 2024).

chapters.name: Mechanical Properties of Fluids
chapters.notes: Covers pressure, buoyancy, viscosity, Bernoulli and surface tension. Advanced excludes Poiseuille's equation.

chapters.name: Thermal Properties of Matter and Heat Transfer
chapters.notes: Main 2026 names conduction, convection and radiation only. Newton's law of cooling and blackbody radiation (Kirchhoff, Wien, Stefan) are named only in Advanced.

chapters.name: Kinetic Theory of Gases
chapters.notes: Main has the full unit (rms speed, degrees of freedom, mean free path). Advanced physics names only ideal gas laws and Cv/Cp; KTG speeds appear in the Advanced Chemistry syllabus instead.

chapters.name: Thermodynamics
chapters.notes: Carnot engine is named in Advanced but not in Main 2026 (reported removed from Main in 2024).

chapters.name: Oscillations (SHM)
chapters.notes: Advanced adds angular SHM and forced/damped oscillations with resonance (added in its 2023 revision).

chapters.name: Waves and Sound
chapters.notes: Doppler effect is named in Advanced but not in the Main 2026 text.

chapters.name: Current Electricity
chapters.notes: Potentiometer is not named in the Main 2026 text (Wheatstone and metre bridge are). RC circuits appear in Advanced under EMI/AC.

chapters.name: Moving Charges and Magnetism
chapters.notes: Biot-Savart, Ampere, force on charges and currents, galvanometer conversions: in both.

chapters.name: Magnetism and Matter
chapters.notes: Main 2026 names bar magnet, para/dia/ferromagnetism and temperature effects. The Advanced magnetism text (as reproduced by Matrix) does not name magnetic materials; the brochure text could not be read past 'Biot-Savart', so verify by hand.

chapters.name: Alternating Current
chapters.notes: Advanced frames this as RC, LR, LC and LCR circuits with DC and AC sources.

chapters.name: Electromagnetic Waves
chapters.notes: Added to Advanced in its 2023 revision (secondary source). Largely NCERT-text based.

chapters.name: Wave Optics
chapters.notes: YDSE, single-slit diffraction and polarisation (Brewster's law, Polaroids) are in both. Polarisation was added to Advanced in 2023 (secondary source).

chapters.name: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
Atoms and X-rays
chapters.notes: Characteristic and continuous X-rays and Moseley's law are named only in Advanced.

chapters.name: Nuclei and Radioactivity
chapters.notes: Main 2026 names nucleus composition, mass defect, binding energy, fission and fusion, but not radioactive decay law or half-life; Advanced names alpha/beta/gamma decay, decay constant, half-life and mean life.

chapters.name: Semiconductor Electronics
chapters.notes: Main only: diodes, LED, photodiode, solar cell, Zener diode and logic gates. Dropped from Advanced in its 2023 revision (secondary source); absent from the 2026 Advanced text.

uncertainties: The 2027 syllabi were not published as of 25 Sep 2026; this map uses the JEE Main 2026 (NTA) and JEE Advanced 2026 (IIT Roorkee brochure, Annexure-I) texts.

The official brochure PDF could only be read up to the start of the magnetism section ('Biot-Savart'). The rest of the Advanced physics syllabus (magnetism, EMI/AC, EM waves, optics, modern physics) was taken from Matrix Academy's reproduction of the official text, which is a paraphrase. Verify phy-magnetism-matter (in_advanced=false) and phy-semiconductors (in_advanced=false) against the brochure pages 76-78 by hand.
vmc_name and vmc_order are null for every chapter: no current public VMC Physics chapter list or teaching order was found.
The chapter split (for example Centre of Mass separate from Rotation, Electrostatics separate from Capacitance) follows common coaching practice; neither official syllabus lists chapters.

'Removed from Main in 2024' items come from coaching/education sites comparing the old and new NTA texts; NTA did not publish a change list. Items marked with the NTA URL are based only on the 2026 text not naming them.
NCERT chapter numbers follow the rationalised editions (Class 11: 14 chapters in two parts; Class 12: 14 chapters in two parts). Check against the printed books.
difficulty and ncert_critical are editorial judgments reflecting common teacher/aspirant descriptions, not a single cited source.

chapters.name: Some Basic Concepts (Mole Concept)
chapters.notes: Advanced also names normality and redox/neutralisation stoichiometry.

chapters.name: Redox Reactions
chapters.notes: Advanced covers redox under General topics (stoichiometry of redox reactions) rather than as a separate unit.

chapters.name: States of Matter: Gases and Liquids
chapters.notes: Removed from Main in 2024; still in Advanced. Dropped from rationalised NCERT, so use the pre-2023 NCERT Class 11 chapter or coaching material.

chapters.name: Solid State
chapters.notes: Removed from Main in 2024; still in Advanced. Dropped from rationalised NCERT (was Class 12 Ch 1).

chapters.name: Electrochemistry
chapters.notes: Advanced also names Faraday's laws, equivalent conductivity and corrosion.

chapters.name: Chemical Kinetics
chapters.notes: Advanced adds catalysis (homogeneous, heterogeneous, enzyme).

chapters.name: Surface Chemistry
chapters.notes: Removed from Main in 2024; still in Advanced. Dropped from rationalised NCERT (was Class 12 Ch 5); the old NCERT text is the best source.

chapters.name: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure
chapters.notes: Advanced: MO diagrams only up to Ne2; VSEPR shapes listed explicitly.

chapters.name: Hydrogen
chapters.notes: Removed from Main in 2024; still in Advanced. Dropped from rationalised NCERT (was Class 11 Ch 9).

chapters.name: s-Block Elements
chapters.notes: Removed from Main in 2024; still in Advanced. Dropped from rationalised NCERT (was Class 11 Ch 10).

chapters.name: p-Block Elements (Groups 13 and 14)
chapters.notes: Main 2026 covers only general trends and unique behaviour of the first element (Unit 10). Advanced names specific compounds (borax, diborane, silicones, silicates, zeolites). Dropped from rationalised NCERT.

chapters.name: p-Block Elements (Groups 15 to 18)
chapters.notes: Main 2026 covers only general trends (Unit 10). Advanced names preparation/properties of NH3, HNO3, oxoacids, O3, H2SO4, interhalogens, xenon compounds. Dropped from rationalised NCERT.

chapters.name: d- and f-Block Elements
chapters.notes: Main names K2Cr2O7 and KMnO4; Advanced names oxoanions of chromium and manganese.

chapters.name: Coordination Compounds
chapters.notes: Advanced adds metal carbonyls and names cis-trans and ionisation isomerism.

chapters.name: Isolation of Metals (Metallurgy)
chapters.notes: Removed from Main in 2024; still in Advanced. Dropped from rationalised NCERT (was Class 12 Ch 6).

chapters.name: Qualitative (Salt) Analysis
chapters.notes: Main includes it under Unit 20 (Practical Chemistry) with its own cation/anion list; Advanced has a separate 'Principles of Qualitative Analysis' section. NCERT lab manual, not a textbook chapter.

chapters.name: Environmental Chemistry
chapters.notes: Not in Main 2026; in Advanced (added in its 2023 revision, secondary source). Dropped from rationalised NCERT (was Class 11 Ch 14).

chapters.name: General Organic Chemistry
chapters.notes: Electronic effects, reactive intermediates, acidity/basicity, IUPAC nomenclature.

chapters.name: Isomerism
chapters.notes: Advanced limits stereoisomers to at most two asymmetric centres and excludes R,S and E,Z configurations.

chapters.name: Purification, Characterisation and Practical Organic Chemistry
chapters.notes: Main Unit 13 covers purification methods and quantitative estimation; Advanced covers detection of elements, functional-group tests and empirical formula by combustion only.

chapters.name: Haloalkanes and Haloarenes
chapters.notes: Advanced excludes the benzyne mechanism and cine substitution.

chapters.name: Carboxylic Acids and Derivatives
chapters.notes: Main 2026 names only acidic strength of carboxylic acids; Advanced names preparation and reactions (esters, acid chlorides, amides).

chapters.name: Biomolecules
chapters.notes: Main names vitamins and hormones; Advanced names maltose, lactose and anomers (added in its 2023 revision, secondary source).

chapters.name: Polymers
chapters.notes: Removed from Main in 2024; still in Advanced. Dropped from rationalised NCERT (was Class 12 Ch 15).

chapters.notes: Removed from Main in 2024; still in Advanced. Dropped from rationalised NCERT (was Class 12 Ch 16).

Collegedunia's 2026 deleted-syllabus article claims Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers and Group 13-14 p-block were removed from Main. The official NTA 2026 text contradicts this (Unit 17 covers alcohols, phenols and ethers; Unit 10 covers Groups 13-18 general trends), so the official text was followed.
The 2024 Main deletions come from coaching/education summaries (a Scribd-hosted coaching sheet and Arpit Classes); NTA did not publish a change list. They match what is absent from the NTA 2026 text.

ncert_chapter is null for chapters dropped from the rationalised NCERT books (States of Matter, Solid State, Surface Chemistry, Hydrogen, s-Block, both p-Block chapters, Metallurgy, Environmental Chemistry, Polymers, Everyday Life). Class 11 numbering assumes the rationalised 9-chapter edition (Part 1: Ch 1-6, Part 2: Ch 7-9); Class 12 numbering follows the 10-chapter edition confirmed by several NCERT-solution sites.
Chemical Bonding is placed under Inorganic; some coaching institutes (possibly VMC) teach it under Physical Chemistry.

Main Unit 20 also lists physical-chemistry experiments (titrations, enthalpy of neutralisation, sols, kinetics of iodide/H2O2) and inorganic preparations (Mohr's salt, potash alum). These will be attached as Main-only topics to the relevant chapters in Section 2 rather than made a separate chapter.
